en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Aban Bin Abdul Malik, from Ismail Bin Jabir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
We<sup>asws</sup> begin with the vinegar in our<sup>asws</sup> presence, just as you all are beginning with the salt in your presence, for the vinegar strengthens the intellect’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from Aban ibn ‘Abd al-Malik from ’Isma‘il ibn Jabir who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
We begin with vinegar which is with us as you begin with salt which is with you, and vinegar strengthens the ability to understand better.’”
